title: Decision tree on a recursive block
statement: For a depth $d$, a block index $i\in\{0,1\}$, and a finite-alphabet decision tree on $2^d$ coordinates, reindex its coordinates into the block of $2^d$ coordinates selected by $i$ among the $2^{d+1}$ coordinates. The resulting tree has precisely that block as its available coordinate set.
hypotheses_covered: a finite-alphabet decision tree on $2^d$ coordinates
